headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: June 30, 2026**
article:
The White Sox took down the Orioles 9-3, with Junior Perez leading the charge. The Rangers secured a 4-2 win over the Guardians, thanks to Jacob deGrom's strong performance. The Phillies dominated the Pirates 8-0, with Trea Turner leading the offense.

Several key players have been placed on the injured list, including Texas Rangers shortstop Corey Seager, who is dealing with lower back inflammation. The Detroit Tigers have also placed Will Vest on the injured list due to right posterior elbow inflammation. Other notable injuries include Connelly Early's left elbow inflammation with the Boston Red Sox and Jeremy Peña's left calf strain with the Houston Astros.

The Athletics have made a move to bolster their pitching staff, acquiring right-handed pitcher Ben Hansen in a trade with the Boston Red Sox. The Seattle Mariners have also made a trade, acquiring first baseman Buddy Kennedy from the San Francisco Giants for cash.

top_news.title: **White Sox Take Down Orioles 9-3**
top_news.summary: The Chicago White Sox secured a 9-3 victory over the Baltimore Orioles, behind a strong performance from their offense. Junior Perez led the charge with a home run and three RBIs.

top_news.title: **Rangers Take Down Guardians in 4-2 Victory**
top_news.summary: The Texas Rangers secured a 4-2 win over the Cleveland Guardians, with Jacob deGrom earning the win after 7.0 innings of work. DeGrom struck out 9 batters and allowed 2 earned runs, while Joc Pederson led the Rangers' offense with a home run and 2 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Pirates Suffer Shutout Loss to Phillies**
top_news.summary: The Philadelphia Phillies dominated the Pittsburgh Pirates 8-0, handing them their latest defeat. Trea Turner led the Phillies' offense with a 2-hit, 3-RBI performance, including a 9th home run of the season.

top_news.title: **Tigers Take Down Yankees 9-3**
top_news.summary: The Detroit Tigers secured a convincing 9-3 victory over the New York Yankees, with Riley Greene leading the charge at the plate. Greene's impressive performance included two home runs and three RBIs, while Tarik Skubal dominated on the mound with six shutout innings and nine strikeouts.

top_news.title: **Seager Lands on Injured List**
top_news.summary: Texas Rangers shortstop Corey Seager has been placed on the 10-day injured list due to lower back inflammation.

top_news.title: **Athletics Acquire RHP Ben Hansen in Trade**
top_news.summary: The Oakland Athletics have made a move to bolster their pitching staff, acquiring right-handed pitcher Ben Hansen in a trade. Hansen joins the Athletics after being dealt from the Boston Red Sox.
